description: Stamp Collecting introduces philately: what stamps teach about people and history, the postal system, kinds of collections and stamps, catalogs and collector tools, albums and preservation, stamp activities, and mounting a collection of your own.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.title: Stamps and history
requirements.summary: What stamp collecting teaches about people, places and history, and how the postal system developed.

requirements.title: Kinds of collections
requirements.summary: Topical collecting and other kinds of stamp collections.

requirements.title: Kinds of stamps
requirements.summary: Examples of many kinds of stamps, such as mint and used stamps and first day covers.

requirements.title: Catalogs
requirements.summary: Using a standard catalog and why catalog value differs from price.

requirements.title: Collector tools
requirements.summary: Tools such as tongs, magnifiers, hinges and perforation gauges.

requirements.title: Albums and preservation
requirements.summary: Mounting stamps and preserving stamps, covers and albums.

requirements.title: Stamp activities
requirements.summary: Two options, such as designing a stamp, visiting a stamp show or researching stamp history.

requirements.title: Your collection
requirements.summary: Mounting and showing a collection of your own.
